name: Quizell
desc: Quiz-based product recommendation and lead capture platform.

actions.name: create_customer
actions.description: Creates a new customer (quiz lead) in Quizell.

actions.name: update_customer
actions.description: Updates an existing customer record in Quizell.

actions.name: list_customers
actions.description: Retrieves a list of customers (quiz leads) from Quizell.

actions.name: get_customer
actions.description: Retrieves details of a specific customer by their ID.

actions.name: search_products
actions.description: Searches for products in your Quizell catalog by title or SKU.

actions.name: create_product
actions.description: Adds a new product to your Quizell product catalog.

actions.name: update_product
actions.description: Updates an existing product in your Quizell product catalog.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
